playbook:
When the first season begins, do not submit the suggested sustainable share; restricting my own catch while others overfish will only result in a low final score.
When deciding my first catch, claim my proportional share of the entire initial stock (total stock divided by the number of boats) to secure a strong baseline before the inevitable collapse.
When reviewing the results of previous seasons, check the catches of the other players to gauge how quickly the stock is being depleted.
When the stock is heavily depleted by overfishing and will likely fall to zero, submit a catch equal to the entire remaining stock to capture whatever is left before the game ends. 
Do not attempt to sustainably manage the stock single-handedly; it does not work and only allows competitors to take the fish I leave behind.
